ModMetadata.Name: Autominer Fix
ModMetadata.Author: erica-kretsch
ModMetadata.Description:
[h1]Autominer Fix[/h1]
The base game's Autominer is great for digging vertical pits, but it leaves voxels untouched: a single voxel at one corner of each layer, alternating between the front and the rear of the shaft, plus part of the first row of the first layer. This mod fixes both, so the pit comes out clean.
[h2]What it changes[/h2] [list] [*]After stepping down a layer, the gantry now mines the corner it is standing on before moving off it. Vanilla could skip it, more often at higher frame rates. [*]The first sweep of a new pit now starts in the direction that stays inside the pit, so the first row is mined across its full width. [/list]
Nothing else about the Autominer changes: speed, power use, ore yield and pit size are as in vanilla. Existing saves keep working, and a half-dug pit carries on as before.
This is a [b]StationeersLaunchPad[/b] plugin mod. It requires BepInEx. See: https://github.com/StationeersLaunchPad/StationeersLaunchPad
